KL-CREACC-BAL.title: CREACC opening balance is not part of the REST surface
KL-CREACC-BAL.detail: COMMAREA COMM-AVAIL-BAL/COMM-ACT-BAL (50, 100, -5000, -125000) are written by COBOL CREACC; POST /banking/account has no balance field (api-contract.md) and the migrated account opens with 0.00. This matches the legacy web path: src/webui/.../web/db2/Account.createAccount inserts 0.00,0.00. Account number, type, rate, overdraft, dates, CONTROL and PROCTRAN all match in these flows; BNK1CAC/create-ok (3270 path) matches fully.

KL-UPDACC-TYPE.title: UPDACC invalid account type rejected by the REST layer
KL-UPDACC-TYPE.detail: Legacy COBOL UPDACC writes ACCOUNT_TYPE=CHEQUE (pre-existing defect 9); the migrated PUT /banking/account/6 returns 400 "Account type CHEQUE is not supported." (updacc/UpdateAccountController.VALID_ACCOUNT_TYPES), exactly like the legacy Liberty AccountsResource.updateAccountInternal (validateType, HTTP 400) that fronted UPDACC for the React UI. Intentional per tickets.md T-07 ("blank or invalid type -> 400").

KL-RANDOM-CUST.title: INQCUST "random customer" (custno 0) picks a different customer
KL-RANDOM-CUST.detail: Legacy always returns customer 0000000001 for both CBSA_RANDOM_SEED=42 and 7 (GENERATE-RANDOM-CUSTOMER is computed from NCS-CUST-NO-VALUE, so the draw collapses to 1); the migrated service draws from CbsaRandom stream 100 (seed+100) over the highest customer number and returns 0000000022 (seed 42). Documented as a known deviation before this run in screens/TranscriptReplayTest.KNOWN_DEVIATIONS and InquireCustomerTranscriptReplayTest. The outcome kind (success) and DB state match.

other: PROCTRAN_REF excluded from every comparison (documented: docs/migration/inventory.md "PROCTRAN_REF is the CICS task number (Java: per-JVM sequence) and is excluded from parity comparisons"). Observed: legacy writes the task EIBTASKN on every row of a task (e.g. DELCUS 4 rows all 000000000100); Java increments per row and CRECUST uses taskn+1 (credit check consumes one number). All other PROCTRAN columns are compared.
ABNDPROC/record: not comparable - the migrated service has no REST trigger for ABNDPROC (only GET /banking/abend).

BANKDATA (batch) is not replayed per flow; its output is the canonical seed itself, and the seed loaded by both sides was verified identical (full CUSTOMER/ACCOUNT/PROCTRAN/CONTROL dump) before every flow.

Migrated EIBTASKN is set through a parity-only test seam (parity/tools/ParityServer.java: resettable TaskNumberSupplier subclass + /__parity reset/exec/dump endpoints); all business beans are the unmodified target/classes.

3270 screen flows have no REST surface: they are driven in-process through com.ibm.cics.cip.bank.core.screens handlers (parity/tools/ScreenParity.java). RETURN COMMAREA bytes are not compared (Java keeps a symbolic state map).

React unit tests: 0 executed. As committed: ReferenceError: TextDecoder is not defined (src/setupTests.js -> enzyme -> cheerio -> undici). With a parity-only TextEncoder/TextDecoder polyfill: Cannot find module 'cheerio/lib/utils' from 'node_modules/enzyme/build/Utils.js' (enzyme 3.11 vs cheerio 1.x). The only test file, src/App.test.js, is the Carbon template test and also imports modules that do not exist in this app: ./content/RepoPage, @apollo/client/testing, @apollo/client. The suite cannot run without changing frontend code (out of scope for parity/**); the React UI was instead driven end to end in Chromium (section 6b).

React UI end-to-end coverage is read-only (customer by number, accounts of a customer, name search, account by number); create/update/delete screens were not driven in the browser. Their REST calls are covered by the API flows, which use the payloads from api-contract.md that the UI sends.
Single-node H2 only; the postgres profile was not exercised by this parity run.

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: UPDACC accepts an invalid account type and writes CHEQUE (UPDACC/invalid-type).
INQCUST custno 0 ("random customer") always returns customer 1 regardless of CBSA_RANDOM_SEED (observed: random-seed-42 and random-seed-7 both -> 0000000001); BNK1DCS non-numeric input inherits it.
BNK1DCS non-numeric customer number: DEEDIT gives 0 -> random customer + "Customer lookup successful."
DBCRFUN payment debits ignore the overdraft; teller debit has no funds check - reproduced identically by Java.
Zero-amount DBCRFUN succeeds and writes PROCTRAN - reproduced identically.
XFRFUN: no funds check; same-account ABEND SAME; missing target fail code 2 after rollbacks - reproduced identically.
UPDCUST ignores DOB/credit score - reproduced identically.
Credit scores depend on EIBTASKN - reproduced identically (CRECUST ok-seed-1234-taskn-500 matches).
INQACCCU zero-accounts vs not-found asymmetry; CREACC lowercase rejection and 9th/10th account rule - reproduced identically.
ABND-TIME uses the minutes field twice (ABNDPROC, not comparable via REST).
BNK1CAC overdraft-length underflow (transcripts send blank-padded fields).
